summary: Iteration 141 - Staff Onboarding Security Lockdown fully tested. Backend: 23/23 tests passed. All security features working correctly: /me endpoint strips sensitive fields (filenames, urls, paths, hmrc_data, email_log), re-upload/re-submit blocked with 400 'locked' message, direct file access returns 401 (unauth), 403 (staff), 200 (admin). Frontend: Staff sees 'locked' chips with security disclaimer, no upload buttons, no filenames, no View links. HMRC tab shows sealed state with 'SUBMITTED & LOCKED' badge. Admin detail drawer shows full HMRC data, image previews, download icons, ZIP bundle and Email buttons.

Staff cannot view, re-upload, or access documents after submission. /me endpoint strips sensitive fields. Re-upload returns 400 'locked'. Direct file access returns 403 for staff, 200 for admin. Frontend shows 'locked' chips with security disclaimer, no upload buttons, no filenames. HMRC tab shows sealed state when submitted. Admin retains full access via detail drawer with all HMRC data, image previews, download icons, ZIP bundle and Email buttons.
